latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of text-to-video-leaderboard.

- Upload videos or use text prompts to compare and rank results from top AI text-to-video models.
- Fast cloud rendering pipeline delivers ranked video results in 30–60 seconds.
- Supports uploads of MP4, MOV, WebM, GIF files up to 500MB.
- Automated session setup with free 7-day token and 100 credits for new users.
- Easily check credits, session status, and export final videos as 1080p MP4.
- Clear instructions and robust error handling for smooth user experience.
